changelog: ONT-WGS: the genome-tree caption names the method actually used (neighbour joining when fewer than 4 genomes, where FastME cannot run) instead of always saying FastME.

previous.changelog: ONT-WGS type strains: (1) fix — when only 2 type strains fall within ANI range (e.g. Priestia megaterium), FastME (needs ≥ 4 genomes) wrote an empty tree and the whole type-strain section was lost ('string index out of range'); small trees now use neighbour joining, and a tree failure no longer removes the ANI table. (2) When other type strains are also ≥ 95 % (B. cereus / B. thuringiensis, Geobacillus zalihae / thermoleovorans / kaustophilus / vulcani, P. megaterium / aryabhattai) the verdict names them and says ANI cannot separate those species. (3) Strain labels: no doubled type mark (BCT-7112TT, KCTC3922(T)T), no 'T' after an empty strain, serovar entries of the same type strain merged (B. thuringiensis serovar berliner ATCC 10792 listed once). Re-analyse to apply.
